# Copilot Instructions — MayaMMD

Trust this file. It is maintained from verified local runs (Windows, 2026-08). Only
search the repo when a detail here is incomplete or proven wrong. When in doubt, read
`docs/` and the repo memory notes before re-deriving behavior.

## What this repository is

- **MayaMMD** imports MMD (MikuMikuDance) assets into Autodesk Maya 2024–2027 on
  Windows/Linux/macOS: **PMX** models, **VMD** motions, **VPD** poses (bone hierarchies,
  IK, skinning, morphs, Bullet rigid-body physics). **Alpha — read-only:** importing/viewing
  only; no editing, no PMX/VMD/VPD export yet.
- **Hybrid codebase:** a C++20 native Maya plugin (`MayaMMD.mll`) is the single entry
  point; it registers C++ nodes/commands then loads the Python package `mmd/` (Maya
  Python 3.10/3.11/3.13; CI uses 3.11). Python-only changes need **no rebuild** — only a
  plugin reload in Maya.
- **Build:** CMake ≥ 3.21 + `CMakePresets.json` (8 presets, Maya 2024–2027 × debug/release).
  Dependencies via **vcpkg** (`vcpkg.json`: bullet3 ≥ 3.25, float precision).
- **Tests:** pytest (Python), Catch2 (C++), and Maya integration suites driven by `mayapy`
  through CTest. Test fixtures are user-provided binary PMX/VMD/VPD files under `assets/`
  (gitignored — never commit binaries).

## Golden rules (hard constraints)

- **Always build with `--config Release`.** Debug configs fail to link on Windows
  (LNK2038 `_ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL` mismatch between the plugin, compiled with
  `_HAS_ITERATOR_DEBUGGING=0` for Maya's libs, and vcpkg's Bullet `*_Debug.lib`).
- **`VCPKG_ROOT` must point to a bootstrapped vcpkg before configuring** — every
  `maya*` preset injects the vcpkg toolchain; without it configure fails immediately.
- **Bullet stays float precision.** Never enable vcpkg's `double-precision` feature;
  `btScalar` must remain `float`.
- **Never hand-edit** `assets/{pmx_model_files,vmd_motion_files,vpd_pose_files}.py` or
  the `assets/*_database/` JSONs — they are generated by
  `scripts/database/generate_file_list.py`.
- **Use naming constants from `mmd/maya/pmx_naming_manager.py`** for every created
  node/attribute name (see `docs/NamingConventions.md`): DAG nodes use short names,
  DG nodes embed the model name prefix.
- **Update `CHANGELOG.md`** (Keep a Changelog, `### Added/Changed/Fixed`) for every
  user-visible change. Commits use `Area: summary` prefixes (e.g. `Physics: ...`,
  `Refactor: ...`, `Docs: ...`).
- A running interactive Maya **locks the deployed `.mll`** — builds then fail with
  "Permission denied". Unload the plugin in Maya (or close Maya) before rebuilding.
- Don't touch `third_party/` (gitignored reference material, not built).

## Build & validate (validated locally, Windows; ~minutes)

Order below is the working sequence. All commands run from the repo root.

**Bootstrap (one-time):** bootstrap vcpkg and set `VCPKG_ROOT`; the Maya SDK is
auto-downloaded (~44 MB stripped) into `out/.sdk/sdk-maya{ver}/` on first configure
(or pre-seed with `python scripts/ci/strip_maya_sdk.py ensure --version 2026`);
Python tooling comes from `pip install ".[dev]"` or the existing `.venv`.

1. **Configure (C++):**
   `cmake --preset maya2026-release -DBUILD_TESTS=ON`
   - `BUILD_TESTS` is **OFF by default** — always pass `-DBUILD_TESTS=ON` to get
     Catch2 tests and CTest targets. Re-running a preset reuses the cached build dir.
2. **Build + install:**
   `cmake --build out/build/maya2026-release --config Release && cmake --install out/build/maya2026-release --config Release`
   - The post-build step already copies `MayaMMD.mll` to
     `out/install/maya2026-release/plug-ins/`; `--install` also emits `MayaMMD.mod`.
3. **C++ unit tests:** `ctest --preset default --output-on-failure -E "maya-integration"`
   → 31 Catch2 tests, ~1.5 s (exe: `out/build/.../tests/unit_tests/core/Release/mmd_core_tests.exe`).
4. **Maya integration tests:** `ctest --preset default -R maya-integration-cmd` (~17 s);
   suite names: `import bone morph vmd vpd node ccd cmd multi context pose-tree`.
   `ctest --preset default -L maya` runs all suites; `maya-integration-all` is very slow
   (3600 s CTest timeout) — prefer per-suite. Requires `mayapy` at
   `C:/Program Files/Autodesk/Maya{version}/bin`; CTest sets
   `MAYA_PLUG_IN_PATH`/`PYTHONPATH` itself. Alternately
   `.venv\Scripts\python.exe tests\integration\run_integration_tests.py <suite>`.
5. **Python checks (the PR gate):**
   - HARD: `ruff format --check mmd tests` — must pass (81 files, instant).
   - HARD: `pytest tests/unit_tests tests/integration/core/ --ignore=scripts --ignore=tests/integration/maya`
     — 340 tests, ~27 s.
   - SOFT: `ruff check mmd tests` and `mypy mmd tests` currently FAIL with hundreds of
     **pre-existing** findings (663 ruff / 156 mypy on Python 3.14) and are
     non-blocking in CI. Don't fix them wholesale; just don't add new findings in
     files you touch.

**Observed failures & workarounds:**
- `cmake --preset ...` without `VCPKG_ROOT` → toolchain error; set the env var first.
- Stale cached SDK paths: if FindMaya picks the wrong Maya version, delete
  `out/build/<preset>/CMakeCache.txt` and reconfigure.
- `clang-format`/`clang-tidy` are **not on PATH locally and not run in CI** — do not
  rely on them (`.clang-format`/`.clang-tidy` configs exist but are advisory).
- `mayapy` can exit non-zero after printing a Qt WebEngine warning even on success;
  judge Maya suites by their printed "All test suites passed!" summary.
- Release packaging is separate: `-DBUILD_PACKAGE=ON`; see `docs/Releasing.md`.

## CI (what a PR must survive)

`.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml` — two jobs on `ubuntu-latest` (Python 3.11):
1. **Python:** `ruff format --check` (blocking) → `ruff check` (warning only) →
   `mypy` (warning only) → `pytest` (blocking) → git-describe version validation →
   `ast.parse` of `scripts/release/{install,build_release,package_release}.py`.
2. **C++:** vcpkg setup → `cmake --preset maya2026-release -DBUILD_TESTS=ON` (uses
   `MAYAMMD_SDK_CACHE_URL` + `GH_TOKEN` secrets for the SDK) → build Release →
   `ctest --preset default -E "maya-integration"`. (Windows/macOS matrix temporarily
   disabled in CI — local Windows builds are the practical validation.)
Replicate locally with steps 1–5 above. `release.yml` builds 12 variants on `v*` tags.

## Layout — where things live

- `CMakeLists.txt` (root): `MayaMMD` plugin target (sources listed explicitly — add new
  C++ files there), `mmd_core` static lib, tests, packaging. `CMakePresets.json`: presets.
- `cmake/`: `FindMaya.cmake` (SDK discovery), `GitVersion.cmake` (version from git tags),
  `MayaMMD.mod.in`, `_version.py.in`/`version.hpp.in` (configured into `mmd/_version.py`,
  gitignored — never commit it).
- `mmd/MayaMMD.cpp`: `initializePlugin` registers native nodes/commands and calls
  Python `mmd.plugin.initializePlugin` (registers `boneMorphNode` + `boneBlendShape`
  command and the UI). All on one "MayaMMD" plugin identity.
- `mmd/core/`: format readers (`binary_reader.py`, `pmx_reader.py`, `pmx_importer.py`,
  `vmd_importer.py`, `vpd_importer.py`, `data_types.py`, `pmx_validate.py`) + Maya-free
  C++ physics core (`rigid_body_simulation.{hpp,cpp}`, `physics_math.hpp`, `common.hpp`,
  `bullet_bridge.hpp`).
- `mmd/maya/`: import orchestration (`pmx_scene_builder.py`, `vmd_scene_builder.py`,
  `vpd_scene_builder.py`), `model_context.py`, `scene_audit.py`, `pmx_model_utils.py`,
  `pmx_naming_manager.py`, `maya_data_types.py`, `maya_utils.hpp`.
- `mmd/maya/pmx/`: `bone_builder.py`, `morph_builder.py`, `rigid_body_builder.py`.
- `mmd/maya/nodes/`: C++ `ccd_ik_solver_node.{h,cpp}`, `rigid_body_node.{hpp,cpp}` (embedded
  Bullet world; per-body `bodies[i]` compound with `bodyJoint` message attribute) and
  Python `bone_morph_node.py`.
- `mmd/maya/cmds/`: C++ `rigid_body_cmd.{hpp,cpp}` (command `pmxRigidBody`),
  `rigid_body_constraint_cmd.{hpp,cpp}` (`pmxRigidBodyConstraint`) and Python
  `bone_blend_shape_cmd.py`.
- `mmd/ui/`: `tool_main_widget.py` (dockable panel), `morph_tree_widget.py` (PySide6).
- `tests/unit_tests/`: `core/` (pytest + Catch2), `maya/`, `ui/`.
- `tests/integration/`: `core/` (pytest, runs with unit tests), `maya/` (mayapy suites +
  `run_all_integration_tests.py`), `test_helpers.py` (loads plugin, WarningCollector).
- `scripts/`: `ci/strip_maya_sdk.py` (SDK download/strip), `database/` (file-list +
  metadata generation), `maya/` (debug/diagnose helpers, `maya_standalone_test.py`),
  `release/` (packaging), `plot_benchmarks.py`.
- `docs/`: `CPPDevelopment.md` (C++ guide), `NamingConventions.md`, `CustomAttributes.md`,
  `MorphImplementation.md`, `Releasing.md`.

## Conventions & C++ API gotchas (from repo memory — trust, don't rediscover)

- Maya matrices are **row-vector**; Bullet is **column-vector** (transpose when bridging).
  MMD→Maya conversions: position `(x,y,-z)`, rotation `(-rx,-ry,+rz)` in degrees.
- `MSyntax` silently rejects short flags > 3 chars. `MArrayDataHandle` has no
  `isDone()/next()` — use `elementCount()` + `jumpToArrayElement(i)`; write dense arrays
  via `MArrayDataBuilder`. Output compound children must be **unit-typed**
  (`MFnUnitAttribute` kDistance/kAngle, degrees) to avoid auto-inserted `unitConversion`.
- MMD `non_collision_group` is a collide-with mask (do not invert). Box `shape_size` IS
  the Bullet half-extent (verbatim, no halving). Gravity is exactly `-9.8`.
- The solver node derives `dt` from `MTime` (no fps attribute); it is stateful and
  declares itself non-cacheable (`getCacheSetup`).
- C++ node/command additions: source files in `mmd/maya/nodes|cmds`, register in
  `MayaMMD.cpp` (MTypeId range `0x00080xxx`), add to the `MayaMMD` target in the root
  `CMakeLists.txt`, add Catch2 cases to `tests/unit_tests/core/CMakeLists.txt`.
- Schema/attribute changes on `pmxRigidBodyNode` are **breaking** — imported scenes must
  be re-imported; note that in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Tests must not assume specific model files beyond what `assets/*_files.py` provides;
  `tests/integration/maya` suites skip cleanly when assets are missing.
